To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

peer-reviewed medical journal can help connect the technological innovations in artificial intelligence to real-world medical practice through rigorous clinical validation by: (1) emphasizing the importance of study design, (2) encouraging registration of clinical validation studies in a public database, and (3) requiring the reporting of the performance of AI algorithms using appropriate statistical methods and metrics in the peer-reviewed publications.

peer-reviewed medical journal can play an important role in the clinical validation of AI systems by: 1) encouraging researchers to register clinical trials of AI systems before the commencement of the trials and to report the trials according to the relevant guidelines, 2) encouraging researchers to design the trials in a manner that allows them to evaluate both the accuracy and efficacy of the AI systems, and 3) encouraging researchers to report their results according to the relevant reporting guidelines.

1) peer-reviewed medical journals should encourage investigators to conduct and publish rigorous clinical research studies to validate AI systems for medical prediction and diagnosis; 2) the clinical research studies should be registered in advance and reported in accordance with the relevant guidelines; and 3) peer-reviewed medical journal editors and reviewers should encourage the investigators to pay closer attention, in their research, to the factors listed herein.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the clinical evaluation of the performance of AI-based technologies designed to make a medical diagnosis or prediction, which is the focus of this article.
the following question: how can we best connect the technological innovations in artificial intelligence to real-world clinical practice through rigorous clinical validation?
the role that peer-review medical journals can play to help achieve the clinical validation of AI systems for making medical diagnosis and prediction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the peer-reviewed medical journals could play a critical role in connecting the technological innovations in artificial intelligence to real-world medical practice by encouraging the investigators to conduct rigorous clinical validation of the AI systems designed for medical diagnosis and/or prediction.

peer-reviewed medical journal editors should pay more attention to the importance of clinical validation and the related study design and reporting issues in order to facilitate the translation of AI technologies for medical diagnosis and prognosis from the research to clinical practice.

peer-reviewed medical journal editors should emphasize the importance of the factors listed in Table 1 to investigators who wish to publish their work on AI technologies for medical diagnosis and/or prediction, and that peer-reviewed medical editors should also encourage investigators to register their studies before the start of their research and to report their results using the reporting guideline for diagnostic accuracy studies, the STARD statement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the peer-reviewed medical journals could help to improve the quality of AI research by emphasizing the importance of the factors we discussed in this article.

the medical journal community should be more proactive in promoting and facilitating the development of clinical research studies to validate the performance and clinical value of AI technologies for medical diagnosis and predictions.

the peer-reviewed journals can help the investigators who wish to evaluate diagnostic accuracy efficacy of AI systems for clinical use by emphasizing the importance of the study design and reporting, and by encouraging the investigators to register their studies in advance.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the peer-reviewed medical journals should be more proactive in helping investigators design and report the validation studies for AI systems for medical use, in terms of the study design, the study registration, and the reporting of the study results.

the current peer-reviewed medical journals’ guidelines on reporting clinical studies on AI systems for medical diagnostic and prediction need to be updated to include specific requirements for study design, registration of the studies, and reporting.
, for AI technologies to be integrated into clinical practice and to benefit patients, rigorous clinical validation studies are essential.
